EXTRAORDINARY
LAND ACQUISITION NOTICE
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7

My No.: DIVKB/LND/LA/DADUR/10/1299. Land Ministry No.: 4/3/9/2012/IR/28. I, hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendments) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following lands which is required for a construction of branch cannel number 04 of the left cannel of Daduru Oya Project.

Description of the land to be acquired: The Allotments of Land Situated in Pahala Halmillakotuwa Village in 1299 - Halmillakotuwa Grama Niladhari Division in Divisional Secretariat Division of Kobeigane in Kurunegala District North Western Province and accordance with F.V.P. 1673 Supplement No. 4 Sheet No. 5 of Kurunegala Survey’s General, as described below.

01. Lot No. 226 Name of the Land: Kithulgahamulahena and Galgodahena; Description: Garden, There are 115 aoconut trees of 35– 40 years old and there are 25 coconut trees of 5-10 years old; Claimant: Government( First owner P.H.M.De Silva, No. 16/A, Don Karolis Road, Jawattha, Colombo– 05); Extent: 0.6344 Hectare.

Boundary Schedule North By: Village Boundary of F.V.P. 1736 ( Walpaluwa) and Lot No.10 I; East By: Lots No. 10 I, 10K and 227; South By: Lots No. 10K, 10J and 10 I; West By: Lot No.10 I and Village Boundary of F.V.P. 1736 ( Walpaluwa).

02. Lot No. 227 Name of the Land: Kithulgahamulahena and Mineepitiyehena; Description: Garden, There are 10 coconut trees of 35– 40 years old, a woodapple tree, a Teak tree, a Helamba tree, there are 2 coconut trees of 15-20 years old and a water whole); Claimant: Government (First owner H.M. Bandarathilaka, Dorabavila, Thuththiripitigama, Kobeigane); Extent: 0.2641 Hectare.
Boundary Schedule North By:Lot No.10 I, 10K,10M and 10L; East By: Lots No. 10L,and 230; South By: Lots No. 228, 10M,10L and 10K; West By: Lot No.10K, 10J and 226.
03. Lot No. 228 Name of the Land: Mineepitiyehena; Description: Scrub and Tank; Claimant: Government (First owner is unknown); Extent: 0.0168 Hectare.
Boundary Schedule North By:Lot No. 227; East By: Lots No. 230 and 229; South By: Lots No. 230, 229, 90 and, 10M; West By: Lot No.10M and 10L

04. Lot No. 229 Name of the Land: Waduressewewa, Helambawewa; Description: Open bare Land and Tank; Claimant: Government; Extent: 0.0025 Hectare.
Boundary Schedule North By:Lot No.228; East and South By: Lot No. 230; West By: Lot No. 230, 90 and 228.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat of Kobeigane on the 20th day of June 2018 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in Writing ( in duplicates) on or before the 13th day of June 2018, the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
N.A.A.S. PRIYANKARA, Divisional Secretary, Kobeigane.
Divisional Secretariat, Kobeigane. 28th March, 2018.
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7

My No.: 6/3/7/15/9/5. Land Ministry’s Ref. No.: LD/05/2007/MV/156D. I, hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of the Section 7 of Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land which are for a public purpose. Description of the land to be acquired: Public purpose means the Land Acquisition for the Moragahakanda & Kaluganga Development Project.

The Allotments of Land Described below, shown in Topo PP 20 supplement No. 133, sheet No. 231 approved by Surveyor General dated on 25.06.2017, situated at E 401A, Galporugolla Grama Niladhari Division, Gangala Udasiya Pattuwa, Naula Divisional Secretary’s Division of, Matale District, Central Province.
01. Lot No. 8584 Name of the Land: Kahatagahamulayaya; Description: Light Forest; Claimant: Mr. Henayale Gedara David of Palugaswewa, Bellankadawala; Extent: 0.1133 Hectare.
All persons interested in the aforesaid land are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents before me at 9.00 a.m. on the 03rd day of 05 2018 at the Naula Divisional Secretariat.

And further you are hereby requested to notify to me in writing ( in duplicate on or before the 25 day of April 2018, the nature of their interest in the Land, the Particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said Land, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
ATHMA DILUKSHI JAYARATHNA, Divisional Secretary, Naula. At Naula Divisional Secretariat, 21st March, 2018.
